method: four read-only /usr/bin/dux status --json samples 10 seconds apart, paired with systemctl show CPUUsageNSec and MemoryCurrent
interpretation: During this 30-second interval, pending updates decreased by 6,045 while new events continued to arrive; no additional kernel overflow or dropped-update count appeared. This indicates short-window backlog drainage during this sample only. The index remained dirty and not caught up, and last full scan age increased by 30 seconds. A short sample does not establish sustainable capacity or accuracy.
limitations: Counters are cumulative daemon counters; event resolution and updates committed are different measures and should not be treated as interchangeable throughput.
The backlog was highly variable immediately before this interval, including a sample of 52,591 pending updates; do not generalize this 30-second decline.
No independent path-level oracle was run.
